title: 润田Runtian
description: This resource pack modifies some items to give you a more realistic and humorous feeling.
body:
This is a material bag about Runtian, who modified the water bottle or some practical items. But because it still has problems, it is only suitable for the whole life at present. Of course, if you are not a Chinese, you may have a hard time understanding this resource pack.

## Currently added items
- Golden Apple
- Enchanted Golden Apple
- Totem of Undying
- Ominous Bottle
- Water Bottle.

![Interpretation of the above text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d67868d2ba3b6d77b945b5af7fed273b7fe4e918.png)

## Possible future additions
- Differentiation of various potions
- Splash Potions
- Lingering Potions
- Mace.

**If you are not satisfied, you can modify it yourself**
